title: Team data committed, personal data gitignored
context: Teams need shared visibility; individuals need scratch space and per-branch reviews that should not land in main.
decision: team/ is committed; personal/ and config.local.json are gitignored. promote and unshare move records between them. Reviews and notes default to personal.
consequences: Everyone with repo access sees team data, and access follows repo permissions. Personal data stays on one machine.
author: noreply@anthropic.com
